ns2:course.label: Frameworks for Health & Wellness: Building Healthy Communities
ns2:course.description: Different disciplines approach issues of health and wellness in distinct ways. This class gathers faculty from the life sciences, humanities, and social sciences to help students build a deep understanding of distinct approaches to health that connect with particular lifestyles, families, cultures, and communities. Students will be able to evaluate goals and strategies to enhance health and wellness. Meets twice per week: first for a lecture that includes all students and faculty, and next in individual faculty-led seminars. Through this structure, students benefit from the expertise of multiple faculty while participating in a seminar with one professor and a small network of peers.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Grand Challenge-Health/Well, Humanities - Hist & Phil, and Cultural Studies - Western course.
